This is the single chokepoint that covers recheck, FAILED_VALIDATION -> READY retries, INTERNAL_ERROR -> READY retries, and run_task entry-time normalization of INTERRUPTED lifecycles. flywheel.lifecycle must stay pure (no json import).

Add a public dataclass `RecheckOutcome(applied: bool, reason: str, per_predicate: tuple[dict[str, object], ...])` in flywheel.harness. Export it from flywheel.harness.__all__ and re-export from flywheel.__init__.

Add public function `recheck_blocked_lifecycle(store: HarnessStore, run_id: str, task: Task, *, dry_run: bool = False, now: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None) -> RecheckOutcome`. Behavior per spec FR-5: (a) load lifecycle; if status != INTERRUPTED or blocked_requires_json is None, return RecheckOutcome(applied=False, reason='not_blocked', per_predicate=()) with NO events emitted; (b) parse the persisted requires JSON back into the BlockedRequirement tuple; (c) evaluate each predicate against worker CWD and process env -- command_grader resolves the named grader from task.graders and runs it via the existing command-grader runner WITHOUT writing a grader_results row; file_exists uses os.path.exists; env_var_set checks os.environ.get(name) for a non-empty value; (d) emit harness.recheck_attempted with payload {per_predicate: [{type, identifier, satisfied, detail}, ...], all_satisfied: bool, dry_run: bool}; (e) if dry_run is True: never emit harness.unblocked and never transition; return RecheckOutcome(applied=False, reason='dry_run', per_predicate=...) regardless of evaluation result; (f) if all satisfied and dry_run is False, transition INTERRUPTED -> READY (which clears blocked_requires_json via the centralized clearer), emit harness.unblocked with payload {from_status: 'interrupted', to_status: 'ready'}, and return RecheckOutcome(applied=True, ...); (g) otherwise return RecheckOutcome(applied=False, ...) with no transition.

non_goals: Do not add the `flywheel recheck-blocked` CLI subcommand or extend `flywheel status` in this task -- both belong to the next task in the phase.
Do not add a manual_ack predicate type or any new predicate type beyond the three already defined in the envelope task.

Do not auto-recheck inside run_task entry-time normalization. Recheck remains explicit-only per spec Decisions Log; the existing INTERRUPTED -> READY drain stays for SIGINT-pause resumes (which have blocked_requires_json IS NULL).
Do not persist recheck command-grader results into the grader_results table -- the recheck event payload is the audit surface (spec Out of Scope).
Do not recreate or re-enter the original attempt's sandbox at recheck time -- caller is responsible for the CWD (spec Out of Scope).
Do not modify the audit-stream sequence semantics -- harness.recheck_attempted and harness.unblocked are ordinary EventRecord rows that share the existing run_sequence counter via append_event.
edge_cases: An INTERRUPTED lifecycle whose serialized requires JSON is unparseable (data corruption) must surface as a RecheckOutcome(applied=False) with a descriptive reason and an emitted harness.recheck_attempted whose payload notes the parse failure -- do not crash the caller.

Two concurrent recheck callers on the same lifecycle: optimistic concurrency on lifecycle.version (existing semantics) decides the winner; the loser surfaces OptimisticConcurrencyError to its caller -- do not swallow it.
command_grader predicate subprocess fails to start (e.g. binary missing): predicate is unsatisfied; detail string includes the OS error; no exception escapes the recheck function.
env_var_set where the variable is set to the empty string: predicate is unsatisfied (spec FR-2 non-empty rule).
file_exists.present=false and the path exists: predicate is unsatisfied.
Recheck called on a DONE / FAILED / PENDING / READY / RUNNING / VALIDATING lifecycle: silent no-op (status != INTERRUPTED branch).

A blocked envelope whose requires list references the SAME command_grader that's also a validation grader on the task: allowed; recheck re-runs the grader exactly as validation would (FR-2 edge case).
